protocol.training: Shared Up/Down ridge regression, lambda 10, standardized on training only; labels are future full-size sell proceeds minus current buy cost, both fees included. Samples every five seconds. Same-round continuous future paths only; no settlement guesses.
protocol.selection: Validation only: minimum 3 completed trades; maximize net minus 0.25 realized drawdown. Diagnostic segment is not used for selection. Compare with no-trade zero.
protocol.promotion: Both validation and diagnostic require >=10 completed trades, positive net, positive net after one extra tick per side, and positive mean-net minus 1.96 standard errors. This is an experimental screen, not statistical proof.
protocol.caveat: Diagnostic forward data was collected after prior parameter study, but aggregate old-strategy outcomes have already been inspected. It is NOT a pristine unseen confirmation. A fresh prospective period remains required.
